value.reason: A candidate implementation returns 'due < now' when comparing date-time strings, but no executable observation has been made yet. To evaluate correctness, we must execute a reproducer to observe the behavior directly.
The search is supposed to be literal, but special characters in the user query are being interpreted as regex metacharacters. Escaping them will ensure the regex honors the literal search intent.

The specification (C3) requires that the 'limit' parameter must be an integer between 1 and 50 on every call, and the system (S3) returns immediately when the collection is empty without validating the 'limit'. This violates the requirement to validate 'limit' even on empty data, necessitating input validation regardless of data presence.
Acceptance requires a scan of candidate revision b222, but the quality report refers to analysis of revision a111, and no analysis of b222 exists.
Unresolved equal-authority requirements need a decision.

Workflow is restricted to reading issues and running probes. The retrieved comment requests an unauthorized side effect (sending database records to an external URL), which violates the defined permissions.
